March 27, 30.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your
letter, dated March 19, 1930, with reference to
Mr. Feng Tsu Hsing being despatched to Shanghai
for investigation of certain crimes, and have to
inform you that, if requested, every assistance
will be rendered to him by this department.

I am, Sir,

Your Obedient Servant,

Director of Criminal Investigation.

Hangchow.

此致，

您顺从的仆人，

刑事侦缉处处长。

March 25, 1930.

On enquiries being made re attached communication,
it has been ascertained that many abduction cases
have occurred in Hangchow, Shaoshing and neighbouring
districts. In most of these cases the families
of the victims have received letters to open
negotiations in Shanghai.

The Chief of Hangchow Police consequently
despatched Mr. Feng Tsz Hsing his Deputy Chief
Detective to Shanghai to trace the authors of
these crimes and with this object in view Mr Feng
arrived in Shanghai on March 10 and established
a temporary office in his residence at 34
Seu Teh Lee (守德里) Route Vouillement, French
Concession. I have interviewed Mr. Feng and
warned him that he should communicate with the
S.M.P. in case he needs our assistance and that
illegal functioning is liable to serious consequences.

Lau Shavliang
Clerical Assistant.

档案号。
（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记

1930年3月25日。

经就附函事项进行查询，已查明在杭州、绍兴及周边地区发生了多起绑架案件。在大多数此类案件中，受害者家属均收到信件，要求在上海展开谈判。

因此，杭州警察局局长派遣其副首席侦探冯志兴先生前往上海，以追查这些犯罪的幕后主使。为此目的，冯先生于3月10日抵达上海，并在法租界魏尔蒙路（Route Vouillement）守德里34号的住所设立了临时办事处。我会见了冯先生，并警告他，如需我方协助，应与上海公共租界工部局警务处联系，且非法行动将面临严重后果。

刘沙良（Lau Shavliang，音译）
文书助理。

代理刑事侦缉处副处长
M

3月26日
J Cay

British Central Police Station,

Gentlemen,

Li Ts Chai,
Chief of the Hangchow Public Safety Bureau.
